races.name: Heather Small Live @LeicesterRaces Saturday 4th July Apprentice Handicap

runners_data.name: Bradbury
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits the weak pace but must overcome his hanging habit that cost him recent wins
runners_data.comment: Hung in front when second to Vietnorm at Ripon latest; 1lb better off here so big shout
runners_data.spotlight: Much improved for handicaps but has thrown away his last two as he looked sure to win before hanging violently in the closing stages (1m2f); still went close on both occasions and the new eyeshield could be a significant addition.

runners_data.name: Heart Sign
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning to hood after 39-day break, needs the headgear to spark improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Not beaten far in a 7f AW maiden but hasn't kicked on at all in handicaps (1m-1m2f); ran okay on second run when once tried in a hood and that aid returns combined with blinkers.

runners_data.name: Captain Cairney
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with proven 1m2f handicap form, returning from long break but retains win record
runners_data.comment: Most exposed of these after seven runs but first and second in 1m2f Chelmsford nurseries
runners_data.spotlight: Had eight runs at two, showing best form when first and second in 1m2f handicaps at Chelmsford; bit to prove on turf but might progress further after being gelded.

runners_data.name: Gwen's Girl
runners_data.note: Only pace-setter gets tactical advantage but must prove stamina beyond her usual sprint distances
runners_data.comment: Has struggled in the last three of her four runs including a 1m handicap last month
runners_data.spotlight: Easily her best run was when second on debut (6f, soft) and has finished well behind in her two handicaps (1m); the cheekpieces need to make a difference.

runners_data.name: Adores
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with concerning finishing fade pattern, step up in trip may help stamina
runners_data.comment: Half-sister to three winners; worth a look but has stamina to prove on her turf debut
runners_data.spotlight: Disappointed at Windsor last time (1m3f) but her fourth on handicap debut (1m AW) has worked out fine and perhaps 1m2f will suit.

runners_data.name: Sahm Naif
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but poor recent form suggests gelding operation hasn't sparked improvement yet
runners_data.comment: Big prices and soundly beaten in 7f and 1m events as 2yo; best watched for new yard
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten between 12l and 18l in his qualifying races (7f/1m), the latest on stable debut after being gelded; may show more in handicaps but hard to be confident.

runners_data.name: Too Darn Spicy
runners_data.note: Hold-up type but weak overall form with no runs closer than 8 lengths in career
runners_data.comment: May still be capable of a bigger effort at this sort of level
runners_data.spotlight: 0-5 and no closer than 8l, with that best run coming on her debut; beaten about 10l and 12l in two handicaps, over 7f on good to firm and 1m on soft.

races.paceDynamic: Gwen's Girl is the only confirmed front-runner in this field and should dictate terms from the start. With six hold-up horses behind her, she's unlikely to face early pressure and can set a sustainable gallop over the 1m2f trip. This creates a tactical race where the pace will likely be steady early before quickening from the 3f pole. The lack of pace pressure strongly favours horses that can travel well and sustain a finish, giving hold-up runners a clear tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Benefits Front
scenarios.trigger: If Gwen's Girl gets an easy lead and stays the trip
scenarios.body: She can dictate fractions and kick clear turning for home, while the hold-up horses get caught flat-footed by the sudden acceleration. Her prominent style perfectly suits controlling this weak pace scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Swamp Leader
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely run from halfway as apprentice jockeys get keen
scenarios.body: Gwen's Girl gets reeled in by better-handicapped closers who can unleash superior finishing kicks. Bradbury's class and Captain Cairney's win record make them prime beneficiaries.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl Suits Improvers
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes a tactical crawl throughout with no injection of speed
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where recent improvement and good form matter most. Captain Cairney's winning experience and Bradbury's recent near-misses give them the edge in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Gwen's Girl stops suddenly or pulls up early in the race
scenarios.body: The field concertinas into a messy scramble where any horse can win regardless of ability. This chaotic scenario opens the door for rank outsiders to capitalise on the confusion.

watchPoints.text: Gwen's Girl could get away with murder on the lead if apprentice jockeys let her dictate soft fractions
Bradbury has violently hung right in his last two near-victories when looking certain to win
Captain Cairney returns from 196-day absence but showed progressive handicap form before the break
Heart Sign needs the returning hood to replicate her better AW form on turf debut for this yard
The apprentice jockeys may get tactical decisions wrong in what should be a slowly-run race

races.name: Go West Live @LeicesterRaces Saturday 4th July Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (GBB/IRE) (Div I)

runners_data.name: Mrs Mole
runners_data.spotlight: April foal; 12,000gns yearling; second foal; dam Listed-placed 7f AW winner (RPR 98), half-sister to 1m6f winner Tristram, out of maiden half-sister to 2m Listed winner King Of Wands; first 2yo runner for the yard this season and she's probably best watched.

runners_data.name: See Amna
runners_data.spotlight: Fifth foal; sister to French 7.5f winner Zelkova, half-sister to Italian 7.5f-1m1f winner Alroucha; dam French 1m1f/9.5f winner (including Group 3; RPR 105), out of 1m2f winning half-sister to useful 1m-1m4f winner Stepping Ahead; yard 19% with 2yos this season and she's an interesting newcomer in this ordinary race.

runners_data.name: Wells Fargos Envoy
runners_data.spotlight: Third foal; dam 6f-1m4f winner (including 2yo; RPR 97), half-sister to 7.5f/1m winner Bob, out of maiden half-sister to 5f-7f winner Crystal Moments; one of two runners for yard and market should guide on debut.

runners_data.name: Better Nature
runners_data.comment: Already gelded and this looks a tough starting point
runners_data.spotlight: Never involved when 20-1 on Windsor debut (6f, good) last month but that was behind a useful prospect and he was only beaten around 5l; wasn't far behind Kach Above in that race and he's a possible improver upped in trip on his second start.

runners_data.name: Kach Above
runners_data.comment: Shaped with promise on Wolverhampton debut last week but that was an ordinary race
runners_data.spotlight: Well-bred colt who made a promising start when fourth at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) last month; only seventh of 12 at Windsor last time but he wasn't beaten far and that was a step forward from his initial effort; sets the standard on that form and he's open to more progress on this step up in trip.

runners_data.name: Parioca
runners_data.spotlight: 15,000gns daughter of Cotai Glory; beaten less than 3l when fifth of six at Southwell (7f; cheekpieces applied) last month but she didn't achieve much in that weak race; blinkers are now tried and she needs a major step forward on this switch to turf.

runners_data.name: Waiting For Archie
runners_data.comment: Lope Y Fernandez half-brother to 6f winner Maynora (RPR 58); market instructive
runners_data.spotlight: Well-held fifth of eight at Thirsk (5f, good to firm) last month, recording an RPR of only 43; this step up in trip could suit on pedigree but he needs major improvement on his second start.

runners_data.name: Lord Ragnar
runners_data.comment: 11,000euros yearling whose dam won over middle distances; may want more of a test
runners_data.spotlight: 11,000euros yearling whose dam won over 12.6f; didn't show much when 33-1 at Windsor (6f, good to firm) last month and he's probably a longer-term prospect.

runners_data.name: Farndale
runners_data.comment: Newcomer; will probably need longer trips to be seen to best effect
runners_data.spotlight: 50-1 and was always behind when sixth of seven on Redcar debut (7f, good) three weeks ago; out of a middle-distance winner and she's probably one for longer trips later on.

runners_data.name: Pertinent
runners_data.spotlight: 66-1 and finished a remote last of ten on her debut here (5f, good to firm) last month; this trip looks a better fit on pedigree but she needs a transformation on her second start.

races.name: Go West Live @LeicesterRaces Saturday 4th July Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (GBB/IRE) (Div II)

runners_data.name: Hoosthat
runners_data.spotlight: Third foal; dam 1m4f AW winner (RPR 64), out of close relative of US 8.5f stakes winner Bobcat Greeley, is granddaughter of half-sister to US 1m4f Grade 1 winner Silver Supreme and to dam of Miesque; yard 3-50 with 2yos last season and he could be a longer-term prospect.

runners_data.name: Mojito Madness
runners_data.spotlight: April foal; 8,500euros yearling, resold 16,000gns yearling; brother to winners Swing Out Sister (5f 2yo; RPR 76) and Seahorse Syd (1m/1m2f including 2yo; 65), half-brother to four winners including Online Alexander (5f including 2yo; 105) and Bnedel (1m AW 2yo/10.4f; 87); dam 7f winner (70); plenty to like on paper and he needs watching in market on debut.

runners_data.name: She Is Mighty
runners_data.spotlight: Second foal; dam 1m2f winner (RPR 74), half-sister to winners Educate (smart 1m-10.4f), Hippolytus (1m2f) and Ban Shoof (9.4f-1m4f), out of 7.4f-1m4f winning half-sister to 6f/7f Group 1 winner Somnus; has a striking pedigree and she needs checking in market on debut.

runners_data.name: Tiora Time
runners_data.spotlight: 16,000gns yearling; fourth foal; half-sister to 6f AW winner Tantomile (RPR 55); dam 7f-1m3f winner (84), half-sister to winners Afta Party (1m Flat/2m1f hurdle) and Line House (7f including 2yo), out of half-sister to 1m6f Group 2 winner Franklins Gardens; has speed and stamina in pedigree and market should guide on debut.

runners_data.name: Celtic Charioteer
runners_data.spotlight: January foal; brother to UAE 9.5f dirt winner Withering (RPR 109); never involved after a slow start on Windsor debut (6f, good) last month but he made some late gains and was only beaten around 5l; should know more this time and he's a likely improver upped in trip.

runners_data.name: Jazzy Bay
runners_data.comment: Not beaten far when sixth of 12 at Chepstow and that form makes him a leading player
runners_data.spotlight: Made encouraging debut when sixth of 12 at Chepstow (6f, good to soft) last month and he built on that when a close third over C&D (good to firm) five days later; that was a small-field seller last time but he has leading claims on that form and yard is 19% with 2yos this season.

runners_data.name: Mottaret
runners_data.comment: First foal from a low-grade 1m4f winner; not the obvious type to make a winning debut
runners_data.spotlight: Has plenty of stamina on dam's side and made an encouraging debut when fourth of seven at Redcar (7f, good; 28-1) three weeks ago; that form puts him firmly in the picture and he should be more streetwise this time; shortlisted.

runners_data.name: Tiger In The Tree
runners_data.spotlight: Dam once-raced (RPR 58) half-sister to a hurdle winner; didn't show much at a big price on Redcar debut (6f, good) last month and she's probably one for later on.

runners_data.name: Jazzy Blue
runners_data.comment: 20,000euros yearling; sister to 1m AW winner Persian Jewel; yard 3-9 with 2yos this year
runners_data.spotlight: Ran green and she finished a remote sixth of eight on Yarmouth debut (6f, good to soft; 18-1) last month; should benefit from that experience but she needs major improvement upped in trip.

runners_data.name: Allaboutthelunch
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to beat a rival on his debut here (5f, good to firm) in April and was out the back again at another big price at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) last month.

races.name: Racing Again This Saturday Evening 13th June Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Vichenza
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner perfectly placed to benefit from the certain strong early pace between the two confirmed front-runners.
runners_data.comment: Bred for the job, half-sister to Listed winner out of Listed winner; interesting newcomer
runners_data.spotlight: Half-sister to 6f/7f winner Zoum Zoum (including Listed; RPR 113); looked inexperienced and had some traffic issues on Salisbury debut (6f, good) last month but she kept on well to finish third of 12 behind the favourite; that form puts her firmly in the picture and she should know more this time; interesting contender.

runners_data.name: Muchacho
runners_data.note: Unknown quantity with 5lb claiming jockey making handicapping difficult, but lightly-raced profile suggests potential improvement.
runners_data.spotlight: 12,000euros foal, £16,000 yearling, 11,000euros 2yo; third foal; closely related to 5f AW winner Love Rock (RPR 59), half-brother to 5.7f winner Plutonic (71); dam 5f 2yo winner (including Listed; 94), half-sister to useful 5f/6f winner Gordon Bennett; has plenty of speed in his pedigree but this looks a tough starting point.

runners_data.name: Heddon Street
runners_data.note: Front-runner returning after 238 days off, faces fitness test against another confirmed pace-setter in small field.
runners_data.comment: Half-brother to nine winners; stablemate of Ballybunion and market should guide
runners_data.spotlight: 32,000euros half-brother to nine winners including My Lea (Italian 5f/6f including 2yo/Group 3; RPR 106) and Royal Lea (Italian 5.5f/6f including Listed; 94); 11-2 on Yarmouth debut (6f, good) last October and he came from off the pace to win in emphatic style; has been gelded since but he's strongly respected under a penalty on his return; cheekpieces added.

runners_data.name: Jellystone Park
runners_data.note: Front-runner with recent race fitness advantage, but must deal with Heddon Street in early battle that could compromise both.
runners_data.comment: Good front-running second at Doncaster last month; now tongue tied; bold bid expected
runners_data.spotlight: Promising fourth on Lingfield debut in March (6f, AW) and he built on that when a front-running second at Doncaster (6f, good; beaten a nose) last month; needs to take another step forward here but it's still early days and he's in the mix with hood added; bolted before the start and withdrawn last Monday (5-2 at the time).

races.paceDynamic: Heddon Street and Jellystone Park will clash from the gates, both confirmed front-runners who must lead to be effective. With only four runners, this creates a fast, honest gallop throughout the 6f with no let-up. The sustained pace will stretch the field and expose any fitness doubts, particularly affecting the returning Heddon Street after 238 days off. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up specialist Vichenza, who can settle off the pace and benefit from the certain strong gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Suits Closer
scenarios.trigger: If Heddon Street and Jellystone Park engage in a speed duel from the start
scenarios.body: The two leaders burn each other out over the fast 6f trip, creating the perfect setup for Vichenza to sweep past in the final furlong. Her hold-up style is ideally suited to capitalize on the inevitable pace collapse.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives Duel
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters can establish a slight edge and dictate terms
scenarios.body: Jellystone Park's recent race fitness gives him the edge over the long-absent Heddon Street, allowing him to see off his rival and hold on. His front-running style works if he can marginally outpace his main pace rival.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Newcomer Spring Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Muchacho shows significant improvement from his debut connections
scenarios.body: The lightly-raced runner benefits from the strong pace and Taryn Langley's 5lb claim to outrun his odds. His unknown style profile could prove effective if he's progressed significantly from his debut effort.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Rusty Favorite Returns
scenarios.trigger: If Heddon Street's class overcomes his 238-day absence and fitness concerns
scenarios.body: The previous winner's superior ability shines through despite the layoff, with Billy Loughnane's guidance helping him time his effort perfectly. His early speed establishes position before holding on grimly.

watchPoints.text: Heddon Street's fitness after 238 days absence when forced into early pace battle with Jellystone Park
Jellystone Park's ability to see off Heddon Street in the crucial early exchange between the two leaders
Muchacho's debut running style which remains unknown despite his pedigree suggesting early pace
Vichenza's settling ability given the certain strong gallop from two confirmed front-runners
The pace battle sustainability over 6f on good to firm ground with only four runners

races.name: DSK Environmental Handicap

runners_data.name: Nebbia
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from 35-day break after underwhelming Windsor debut, needs strong pace to be effective
runners_data.comment: Promising seasonal/handicap debut at Windsor this month; still has time to do better
runners_data.spotlight: Unplaced on handicap/seasonal debut at Windsor (6f, good to firm) but she wasn't beaten far into fifth and she shaped as though the run would bring her on; capable of better.

runners_data.name: Percy's Star
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid Windsor second form, well-in on handicap debut with cheekpieces added for first time
runners_data.comment: Beat all bar the market leader over C&D last time, despite still seeming green; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Finished last of the four at Windsor two weeks ago but he looks well-in for handicap debut on his previous second there (6f, good to firm), and cheekpieces are now added.

runners_data.name: Life After Love
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with AW wins but showed turf ability at Lingfield, drops 1lb and suits sprint finish
runners_data.comment: Made it 3-3 over Southwell's 5f last time; needs more again upped 4lb on her turf debut
runners_data.spotlight: All three wins at Southwell but seemed fine on turf debut when beaten a little over 2l at Lingfield (good); down 1lb; can run well.

runners_data.name: Love Alive
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who is most exposed after nine starts, won on AW but disappointing recent Redcar effort
runners_data.comment: 5f AW win in February for Martin Dunne; makes stable debut with yard having a cold spell
runners_data.spotlight: The most exposed of these after nine runs and the win came on the AW (5f; off 2lb higher); only sixth of eight on recent stable debut at Redcar.

runners_data.name: Enter Sandman
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with strong AW form using tongue-tie and cheekpieces, needs to transfer improvement to turf
runners_data.comment: Progressed on the AW this spring; needs to transfer the improvement to turf upped 4lb
runners_data.spotlight: Has done well on the AW since fitted with a tongue-tie and cheekpieces, coming away with the favourite last time; raised another 4lb so needs to transfer the improvement to turf.

runners_data.name: Bessie Wallis
runners_data.note: Prominent runner wearing hood for first time, limited form but David Menuisier stable in good form
runners_data.comment: Found a weak AW novice here last autumn; has to prove this mark within range
runners_data.spotlight: Won a weak AW novice last season; no further improvement this term and behind Life After Love last time; the hood needs to bring her on.

runners_data.name: Davorge Nation
runners_data.note: Prominent type returning from 268-day break after wind operation, has nursery-winning form on good ground
runners_data.spotlight: First (5f, good) and a close third (6f, AW) in nurseries before a quiet run on good to soft at Musselburgh; returns on a competitive mark and after a wind operation; could feature.

runners_data.name: I'm Dan Dare
runners_data.note: Front runner who won well at Catterick after stable switch, only pace angle but faces stronger opposition
runners_data.comment: Ex-Adrian Nicholls; nose second two runs back (headgear tried); chance on stable debut
runners_data.spotlight: 0-6 for Adrian Nicholls; was backed on recent stable debut at Catterick (5f, good to firm) and he was never headed in winning well; that was a Class 6 and he's gone up 8lb, so has more on his plate; still much respected.

races.paceDynamic: I'm Dan Dare is the only confirmed front runner and should get an easy lead with Percy's Star and Bessie Wallis likely to settle prominent behind him. The moderate early pace will allow the numerous hold-up horses (Nebbia, Life After Love, Love Alive, Enter Sandman) to stay in touch without expending energy. This should set up a sprint finish where positioning and traffic become crucial, with I'm Dan Dare potentially vulnerable to late closers if the pace becomes too steady. This race shape strongly favors prominent runners who can track the leader and kick clear before the hold-up brigade arrives.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If I'm Dan Dare dictates a sensible pace without pressure
scenarios.body: The leader can control fractions and kick for home at the optimal moment, making it difficult for hold-up horses to close the gap in time. His recent Catterick win showed he can sustain a strong gallop when allowed to bowl along freely.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If Percy's Star or Bessie Wallis sit perfectly behind I'm Dan Dare
scenarios.body: The prominent runners can stalk the steady pace and deliver their challenge at the furlong pole before the hold-up horses organize their runs. This tactical positioning proves decisive in a sprint finish where every length matters.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Success
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too pedestrian allowing closers time
scenarios.body: Life After Love and Enter Sandman can use their proven finishing kicks to sweep past tiring leaders in the final 100 yards. The AW form winners show they have the acceleration needed when getting the right race setup.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If I'm Dan Dare goes too fast early or ties up dramatically
scenarios.body: The entire field converges in a blanket finish where any horse with a turn of foot can capitalize on the chaotic finish. This favors horses with recent form and fitness advantages regardless of running style.

watchPoints.text: I'm Dan Dare could get loose on the lead if Percy's Star and Bessie Wallis don't track him closely enough early
Percy's Star making handicap debut with cheekpieces - headgear change often signals improvement but can backfire
Enter Sandman's tongue-tie and cheekpieces combination worked on AW but turf debut with this setup needs watching
Davorge Nation returning from 268-day layoff after wind operation - fitness and breathing under pressure questionable
Life After Love stepping back up from recent Lingfield effort where she showed turf adaptation ability

races.name: Hugh James Classified Stakes

runners_data.name: Shark Two One
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with excellent Leicester record but form dipped badly last time at Doncaster
runners_data.comment: Shaped with promise on Leicester reappearance and he looks interesting back up in trip
runners_data.spotlight: All five wins have been on turf and latest was in this race last year; his form nosedived at Doncaster last month but he has a striking record at this track and is versatile ground-wise; big player if he can bounce back.

runners_data.name: Bungle Bay
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with strong recent AW form but poor 0-12 turf record creates doubt
runners_data.comment: All eight wins have come here, five over this trip; 1-1 at this level and much respected
runners_data.spotlight: All eight wins have been at Wolverhampton and he went close in a classified event there (7f) last Tuesday; record of 0-12 on turf but he has placed form in this sphere and he seems fairly versatile ground-wise; key player.

runners_data.name: Eulalia
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse struggling for new trainer despite good winter form for previous yard
runners_data.comment: Lightly raced filly but she's been well held in most of her runs; hard to weigh up
runners_data.spotlight: Ended last season with a good third in a Kempton handicap (7f, AW) for Charlie Fellowes; looks interesting on that form but she's struggled in both runs for current yard and is now 0-7; blinkers added.

runners_data.name: Coverbridge
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse dropping back in trip but generally well held this season
runners_data.comment: A 7f AW winner as 2yo; just minor handicap form since April 2025 for this yard
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win was in a Newcastle maiden (7f, AW) two years ago and he's been well held in his three runs season; this big drop back in trip could help but others are more convincing; cheekpieces reapplied.

runners_data.name: Kode Grey
runners_data.note: Front-runner who fades late but gets uncontested lead and tries 7f for first time
runners_data.comment: Good pace when third on handicap debut at Ripon 12 days ago and he's on the shortlist
runners_data.spotlight: Improved form when a front-running third in Ripon handicap (6f, good) last month but she failed to back that up at Carlisle ten days ago; still lightly raced but she has bit to prove again back up in trip.

runners_data.name: Shes Got The Blues
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in decent recent form but remains a 14-race maiden
runners_data.comment: 13-race maiden who is the most exposed contender
runners_data.spotlight: 14-race maiden but she's reached the frame in three of her last four runs including when fourth of 14 in a Windsor handicap (1m, good to firm) last time; should get a decent pace on this drop back in trip and she should go well again.

runners_data.name: Tilsworth Max
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid AW winter form but hasn't threatened since returning to turf
runners_data.comment: In good form on AW during the winter but he didn't shine back on turf last month
runners_data.spotlight: Plenty of good efforts on AW during the winter, including a win at Lingfield (7f) in January; that form puts him in the picture but he hasn't threatened back on turf in last two runs and overall record is now 1-29.

runners_data.name: Demetris Mouflon
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who was well beaten by 12 lengths when blinkers added last time
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced filly but she's been well held in most of her runs including when a 12l fifth in Lingfield handicap (7f, good; blinkers added) last month; that was after eighth months off but she needs improvement on this drop into a classified event.

runners_data.name: Bridgefoot Rambler
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 49 days off with very poor recent form
runners_data.comment: Has struggled at big prices in two runs on turf and the latest was on recent stable debut
runners_data.spotlight: Struggled at big prices in her three runs including in two starts over 1m (good/AW) this spring; now drops into a classified event but she needs a transformation with cheekpieces added.

runners_data.name: Tickhill Flyer
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse struggling in three runs this spring and drops to classified company
runners_data.comment: Half-brother to three winners but well beaten at big odds last month on first two starts
runners_data.spotlight: Half-brother to three winners but he's struggled at big odds in three runs (5f-7f) this spring; now drops into a classified event but he needs a transformation with cheekpieces added.

runners_data.name: Due Destiny
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse switching trainers with hood added after poor stable debut
runners_data.comment: Poor form for Archie Watson last year; hooded for stable/seasonal debut
runners_data.spotlight: Poor form in four 2yo runs for Archie Watson and was a well-held fifth in Lingfield handicap (6f, AW; hood added) on stable debut in April; should benefit from that run but she needs a major step forward at this new trip.

runners_data.name: Squashy Berry
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who fades late and was beaten 20 lengths last time despite blinkers
runners_data.comment: Big prices and well beaten in two starts over 6f; likely one for handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: Has struggled in his three runs this year and was beaten 20l in a Lingfield maiden (7f, good) last time; still early days but he needs blinkers to make a big difference on this drop into a classified event.

runners_data.name: Miss Helena
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 74 days off with eyeshield and blinkers after poor form
runners_data.comment: Modest form in a variety of events and headgear to date; still fairly early days
runners_data.spotlight: Struggled in two bumpers last autumn and same story at massive prices in four Flat runs this year; equipment now returns but she has stacks to find on the figures and can only be watched.

races.paceDynamic: Kode Grey will go out to make the running with no obvious pace pressure from this field, creating a sustainable tempo through the early stages. Shark Two One and Shes Got The Blues may take up prominent positions but are unlikely to pressure the leader aggressively. The moderate pace will allow the hold-up horses to stay in touch before the race develops into a sprint finish over the final two furlongs. This measured gallop and sprint finish clearly favours the hold-up horses who can finish strongly, with the prominent runners also having chances if they can quicken off the steady pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Kode Grey sets uncontested fractions and the pace stays moderate throughout
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks in the final furlong. Horses like Bungle Bay and Tilsworth Max can use their closing speed to maximum effect.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent runners strike
scenarios.trigger: If Shark Two One or Shes Got The Blues can get first run on the field turning for home
scenarios.body: They can steal a march on the hold-up brigade before the closers get into gear. The prominent position gives them tactical advantage in a moderately-run race.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Kode Grey wire-to-wire
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runner can find extra stamina over this longer trip and resist late challengers
scenarios.body: Despite her tendency to fade, the uncontested lead and step up to 7f could see her last home. The lack of early pressure becomes crucial to her chances.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If the early gallop becomes pedestrian and turns into a pure sprint from the furlong pole
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery where any horse with a turn of foot can win regardless of position. Form and class become secondary to who gets the clearest run.

watchPoints.text: Kode Grey has shown a tendency to fade in the finish which could be crucial if she faces any late pressure
Bungle Bay's 0-12 turf record is a major concern despite his solid recent all-weather form
Shes Got The Blues has been consistent recently and Billy Loughnane's 9/44 record for Tony Carroll suggests stable confidence
Several horses including Squashy Berry and Miss Helena have shown they fade badly in the finish
The good to firm going conditions should suit most of this field with no major ground concerns evident

races.paceDynamic: Zatsgood, Percy's Daydream, and Ted Le Saux will ensure a strong gallop from the outset over this stamina-testing 1m2f trip. Zatsgood brings AW speed but unproven stamina, while Percy's Daydream has the pedigree for the distance despite poor recent form. The sustained pace will stretch the field out early, with the genuine stayers coming through in the final two furlongs. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses with proven stamina reserves who can benefit from the collapse of early pace-setters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners engage in early battle and weaken from 3f out.
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will find out the stamina limitations of Zatsgood and expose Percy's Daydream's poor recent form, allowing patient rides to sweep through late. Noble Horizon and The Green Mile have both won at the trip and suit this tactical setup perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survives Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If one pace-setter can dictate without serious early challenge and conserve energy.
scenarios.body: Ted Le Saux remains unexposed at the trip and could steal a march if allowed easy fractions, while Zatsgood has the class edge despite stamina doubts. The Andrew Balding polish gives Ted Le Saux the tactical nous to survive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Seagolazo and Woodstock City can track the pace without being drawn into early speed battle.
scenarios.body: These two can sit just off the leaders and have the stamina to kick when the front-runners weaken around the bend. Both have shown decent recent form and the tactical speed to respond to the pace collapse.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If all three leaders go too fast early and come back dramatically in final furlong.
scenarios.body: The extreme pace scenario allows a stone-cold closer to come from last to first in a slowly-run finish. Only the most patient rides from deep will benefit when everything comes back to them.

watchPoints.text: Percy's Daydream breaking from stalls again after previous issues could disrupt her early positioning.
Zatsgood's stamina limitations showing from 2f out as turf debut at this extended trip may find him wanting.
Noble Horizon getting strong early position under De Sousa as his hold-up style needs the right tactical setup.
Ted Le Saux being allowed easy early fractions by the other front-runners which would suit his unexposed profile.
The Green Mile settling better with hood reapplied as his temperament issues have affected past runs.

races.paceDynamic: Bridget's Baby will likely lead from the stalls with several prominent racers including Antiphon, Dreambird Dolly, and Dunnington Lad tracking close behind in the early stages. The pace should be sustainable rather than frantic given only one confirmed front runner, allowing the field to stay compact through the first half. A Lott Of Kane and Ziva's Star from the rear will need the pace to be strong enough to set up their closing kicks. This moderate pace scenario clearly favours prominent racers who can position close to the pace and have the tactical speed to strike in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Bridget's Baby sets a steady pace without being pressured early
scenarios.body: The compact field allows prominent runners to travel comfortably before striking, negating the chances of hold-up horses who need a stronger gallop. Dreambird Dolly and Antiphon are perfectly positioned to capitalize from their tracking positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes surprisingly strong with multiple horses vying for the lead
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and sets up a closing finish where stamina tells over pure speed. A Lott Of Kane's hold-up style becomes a major asset in this unfolding.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Bridget's Baby gets an uncontested lead and the field allows her too much rope
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the leader to control fractions and kick clear when the field closes, making the race a pursuit from too far back. De Sousa's experience becomes crucial in judging the right moment to quicken.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If no horse wants the early lead and the field crawls through slow fractions
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from the 2f pole where natural speed dominates over tactical positioning. This randomizes the outcome and could favor any horse with a turn of foot regardless of their usual running style.

watchPoints.text: Bridget's Baby could steal a march if given too easy a lead as the field may not have enough early pace to apply pressure
Dreambird Dolly's headgear change after her Brighton second could provide the crucial improvement needed to break her maiden
A Lott Of Kane faces a significant test moving from all-weather surfaces to turf for the first time in his recent winning form
Dunnington Lad's 5lb claiming jockey Cian Horgan needs to prove he can handle the tactical demands of this competitive field
The going has firmed up from good to good-to-firm throughout the card which could catch out any horse preferring softer conditions
